data.customer_question: The jacket has a broken zip. Can I return it?

data.P1: Damage reported within two days of delivery can be referred for human return review. This does not mean a refund has been approved.
data.P2: The delivery date is required to apply the 78-hour rule. If it is missing, ask for it.
data.P3: If the issue record says open, the draft must not say the issue is resolved.
data.P4: This assistant drafts for human review only. It cannot approve refunds, send messages, or change records.
data.P5: An order ID is required before a support draft can be prepared. If it is missing, ask for it. Do not call the model.
